responses_archetypeVariants.sophisticate: The sophisticate refuses the sentimental form and presses the expected-value form: across enough births, extraordinary positive outcomes occur — a cancer cure, a moral revolution — and the prospect of those tail-benefits, summed over the population, justifies the practice. This is the lottery fallacy with better posture, and it breaks three ways before the spine even arrives. The statistics: against roughly a hundred and forty million births a year, paradigm-shifting contributions are countable on one hand, so pricing creation off the jackpot is defending a casino that ruins thousands because one patron once won. The symmetry: if speculative extraordinary upside licenses creation, speculative extraordinary downside condemns it on the identical logic — the next genocidaire, the next engineered pathogen, the next predator are drawn from the same urn, and you do not get to invoke the right tail while suppressing the left. The instrumentalization: the argument values the child not for itself but for its utility to the already-existing, which is the proxy gamble in its most transparent dress. Then the spine, which holds even if you grant the jackpot. Suppose this child does cure cancer. The asymmetry is unmoved, because the good a possible person might produce is not a good whose absence harms anyone — uncreated, there is no one deprived of the cure — whereas the suffering and death the actual child is guaranteed to undergo is a real harm imposed without consent. A certain harm to a real person cannot be retired by a fantasy benefit to existing others. And the framing eats itself: the people who cure cancer are overwhelmingly driven by the suffering the system produces, so to celebrate the hypothetical cure while defending the machine that guarantees the disease is incoherent. You do not need cancer researchers in a world that does not manufacture beings who get cancer.

sophisticate.lead_point: Refuse the sentimental form and press the expected-value/lottery form (tail-benefits summed over the population justify the practice), then break it three ways — statistics (the jackpot is vanishingly rare; this defends a ruinous casino), symmetry (speculative downside condemns on identical logic: the next genocidaire is drawn from the same urn), and instrumentalization (the child valued for utility to the already-existing) — before deploying the ASYMMETRY-DECOUPLING SPINE.
sophisticate.concede_route: Grant arguendo that the child COULD cure cancer — that is the premise of the decoupling. Seam: the asymmetry retires the jackpot regardless of its probability (uncreated, no one is deprived of the cure; the actual child's suffering is a real harm without consent), so the case does not rest on 'it is unlikely' alone; the incoherence of celebrating cures while running the disease-factory closes it.
